# Workout Guide artwork

Source: https://github.com/bryllim/workout-guide
Pinned revision: `aac599224bb9780305239607ef98540b7e0ce389` (package version 1.0.0).

This project bundles three unmodified 512 × 512 SVG frames for each of eight exercises: bench press, push-up, pull-up, seated cable row, lat pulldown, bicep curl, squat, and deadlift. Files are served from `/workout-guide/{slug}/frame-{1,2,3}.svg`; `public/workout-guide/manifest.json` preserves the upstream exercise metadata and frame-level attribution.

Artwork is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0, with credit to Bryl Lim and Everkinetic. The upstream software and documentation license is MIT. Exact upstream license and attribution notices are included beside this file and in `public/workout-guide/`.

Visible attribution on illustrated workout pages and exports: **Workout Guide · Bryl Lim / Everkinetic · CC BY-SA 4.0**. Link the project (https://github.com/bryllim/workout-guide) and license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

Browser CSS may use the SVG as a mask to apply the chosen theme color; this changes the display color without changing the stored SVG or pose. Any distributed adaptation of the artwork must keep the CC BY-SA 4.0 license, preserve attribution, and identify changes. Frame-level upstream derivations and source URLs are recorded in the manifest.
